current_date: July 2026 (cover page of 'Wandsworth Borough Council Local Validation Checklist')
current_evidence: The cover reads 'Local Validation Checklist July 2026'. The council's apply-for-planning-permission page points to 'the new version of the Local Validation Checklist', and planning.data.gov.uk lists this exact media/d1jhsd5t URL as Wandsworth's local validation checklist. An older copy at media/4816 still exists.

issues.detail: Householder (and Listed building consent) are marked 'No specific local requirements identified', but the checklist's triggers cover all applications. Requirements that apply to householder schemes include: Tree Survey/Arboricultural Report (trees within or adjacent to the site); Heritage Statement (any application affecting a heritage asset or its setting); Fire Safety Strategy ('All developments', with exemption statements for smaller schemes); Daylight and Sunlight (impact on host or adjoining properties); Flood Risk Assessment (within a Flood Risk Area); Archaeological Assessment (ground disturbance in APAs); Construction Method Statement for basements to listed or heritage buildings; Landscaping (changes to landscaping); Heliport info (Red zone, all development types). For LBC, the list has a dedicated 'Schedule of Works Affecting Listed Buildings and Structural Impact Assessment' and the Heritage Statement.
issues.evidence: Item 27 Heritage Statement: 'All applications affecting a heritage asset and or its setting must be accompanied by a Statement of Heritage Significance'; item 44 Tree Survey: 'Where there are trees within a proposed application site, or on land adjacent to an application site'; item 2: 'All developments should include a Fire Safety Strategy'.

issues.detail: Several local requirements that apply to small and minor schemes are missing. Small Sites Affordable Housing Statement applies to schemes of 1-9 residential units (gross). BREEAM Pre-Assessment applies to all non-residential applications over 100 sq m. BREEAM Domestic Refurbishment applies to changes of use to residential. Carbon Dioxide Emissions / Zero Carbon applies to major and non-major new-build residential. Heliport Supporting Information applies in safeguarded zones (Red zone: all development types; Pink over 30m; Blue over 90m; Yellow over 150m). Parking Survey applies where development is likely to reduce on-street parking. Affordable Workspace Management Plan applies to all development providing economic floorspace.
issues.evidence: Item 49 'Small site schemes proposing 1-9 residential units (gross)'; item 7 'All non-residential planning applications over 100sqm'; item 8 'Where proposals are for a change of use to residential'; item 26 Heliport 'Red zone – All development types'; item 5 'All development that provides economic floorspace...'.

issues.detail: Major and strategic requirements missing from Grokbot: Circular Economy Statement (GLA referable); Whole Life Cycle Assessment (all major); Carbon Offsetting; Community Facilities Assessment (Policy SDS1 A.1 locations); Arts and Culture Action Plan (100+ dwellings or 10,000 sq m+ non-residential); Construction Logistics Plan and Delivery and Servicing Plan (Mayoral referable); Marketing Report and Justification Statement; Student Housing Management and Maintenance Plan (all student accommodation; only a fragment appears, mislabelled as Outline 'Crime prevention'); Urban Greening (all major); Metropolitan Open Land Assessment; Open Space, Sport, Recreation and Green Infrastructure Assessment; Healthy Streets Assessment; Fire Safety Statement (all major) as distinct from the Fire Safety Strategy.
issues.evidence: Items 9, 10, 13, 15, 17, 31, 33, 38, 45, 46, 47, 25, 3, e.g. item 17 'Development of 100 or more dwellings or non-residential developments of 10,000sqm or more'; item 10 'All major applications must submit a Whole Life Cycle Assessment.'

issues.detail: Several triggers misstate the threshold. 'Viability Assessment' = 'part of a viability assessment or Planning Statement submitted with an application).'; the source requires it for any development of 1+ gross dwellings or more than 1,000 sq m of economic floorspace. 'Health Impact Assessment' = 'The HIA should start at RIBA Stage 0 or 1'; the source trigger is 50+ residential units. 'Tall buildings / Wind' has a modelling sentence instead of the trigger: 7+ storeys or 21m+, whichever is lower. 'Heritage Statement' has the Heliport safeguarded-zone text (Red/Pink/Blue/Yellow zones) glued to the front.
issues.evidence: Item 48: 'Developments comprising or capable of delivering 1 or more gross residential dwellings'; item 24: 'All development proposals which include 50 or more residential units'; item 39: 'buildings that are 7 storeys or over or 21 metres or more from the ground level to the top of the building (whichever is lower)'.

issues.detail: Many other Full planning triggers are fragments with no 'which applications' condition. Examples: 'Flood Risk Assessment' = 'should submit a Flood Risk Assessment.' (missing 'within a Flood Risk Area' and 1ha+ in Flood Zone 1); 'CIL' = 'in determining CIL liability.' (missing 100 sq m+ or any new dwelling); 'Design and Access Statement' = 'part of a Design and Access Statement.'; 'Structural Survey' = 'or Chartered Structural Engineer (MI Struct.'; 'Planning Statement' gives a definition rather than the trigger ('All applications for full and outline planning permission'); 'Energy' omits 'All new residential development and major non-residential development'; 'Air Quality' omits 'Major or large-scale applications...'. 'BNG' carries Affordable Workspace text and the stale note 'BNG requirements will come into force later this year (2023)'. 'Waste' and 'Existing and proposed site levels' contain national-requirement table headings (Application Form, Fee, Ownership Certificate).
issues.evidence: Item 20 FRA: 'All applications that fall within a Flood Risk Area should submit a Flood Risk Assessment'; item 14 CIL: '...creation of 100 square metres or more ... or involve creation of a dwelling (even where below 100 square metres)'; item 1 Planning Statement: 'All applications for full and outline planning permission.'

issues.detail: All 30 Full planning rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Outline gets only one row, a student-housing fragment labelled 'Crime prevention'. Yet most triggers are scale- or location-based and apply equally to outline; the Planning Statement explicitly covers 'full and outline'. 'Floor plans / Elevations' and 'Roof plan' are placed under 'Change of use - prior approval' because national-requirement text mentions 'applications for change of use'. Those are planning applications, not prior approvals.
issues.evidence: Change of use rows' trigger: 'Official 4.Floor and Roof Plans 5.Section Plans 6.Elevations Applications that involve building works and applications for change of use...' (national requirements table).

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' under Full planning carries the basement Construction Method Statement text. The real listed-building item, 'Schedule of Works Affecting Listed Buildings and Structural Impact Assessment' (basements or significant structural alterations to or adjacent to listed buildings), is not captured with its trigger. 'Construction (Environmental) Management Plan' carries the same basement text instead of the CMP trigger: all major applications, confined sites/basements, near sensitive receptors, substantial demolition/excavation.
issues.evidence: Item 28: 'Where an application seeks to add a basement/significantly alters structure to or adjacent to Listed Buildings'; item 29 CMP: 'All major planning applications ... Developments of sites in confined locations (including basements and subterranean developments) or near sensitive receptors'.

issues.detail: 'Construction (Environmental) Management Plan' and 'Schedule of works (listed building)' have identical triggers. 'Transport Assessment / Transport Statement' and 'Travel Plan' share the same Healthy Streets fragment. The source's separate Transport Assessment (major/TfL thresholds), Transport Statement (non-major with parking impacts) and Travel Plan triggers are lost. tab_items repeat the linear scale bar rule twice ('required' and 'useful').
issues.evidence: Item 41 Transport Statement: 'All non-major applications that could give rise to transport impacts such as the loss or increase of parking provision'.

issues.detail: Some tab_items are guidance or optional text, not requirements: 'For more information on the planning designations, the Checklist should be considered alongside the Wandsworth Maps webpage.' and 'Photo montages ... may be helpful.' The three viability-redaction tab_items are submission detail for the Viability Appraisal, not standalone submission rules.

The list date 2026-07-01 matches the cover ('July 2026'), but Grokbot's date basis is 'PDF metadata CreationDate' rather than the document text. Grokbot also did not flag the internal inconsistency: the July 2026 document still says 'BNG requirements will come into force later this year (2023)'.
issues.evidence: Cover: 'Wandsworth Borough Council Local Validation Checklist July 2026'; item 6 note '(Please note BNG requirements will come into force later this year (2023))'.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Wandsworth Local Validation Checklist (cover dated July 2026), but extraction is weak. Householder and LBC are wrongly marked as having no local requirements, and about 20 of the 50 local items are missing, including the Small Sites Affordable Housing Statement (1-9 units), BREEAM, Heliport zones, Whole Life Cycle and Urban Greening. Many triggers are fragments or misstate the thresholds (viability 1+ dwellings, HIA 50+ units, tall buildings 7 storeys/21m).
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
